product.one_liner: Clearfy is an AI writing review tool that helps users check AI-likelihood signals and revise AI-heavy text into clearer, more natural writing.

core_features.description: Check pasted text or uploaded files for AI-generated writing signals.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users understand where a draft may look AI-heavy before they revise or submit it.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of pasting an essay or uploading a file, clicking Check for AI, and showing AI-likelihood results.

core_features.description: Rewrite AI-heavy or robotic phrasing into more natural human-like wording while preserving the original meaning.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users polish drafts that sound too robotic or generic.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of selecting AI-heavy text, running the humanizer, and comparing before/after wording.

core_features.description: Review sentence-level AI signals so users can identify which parts of a draft need revision.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users focus editing time on the passages that look most robotic.
core_features.visual_need: Close-up screen recording of highlighted or scored sentences and the user revising those passages.

core_features.description: Start from pasted text or uploaded writing files.
core_features.user_benefit: Makes it easy to review full essays or drafts without manually breaking them into small pieces.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of switching between Paste Text and Upload File, then starting a check.

core_features.description: Use one credit balance for AI checks and revisions, with credits that do not expire.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users avoid subscriptions when they only need occasional AI checks or rewrites.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of pricing or credit balance only if needed for a value-prop beat.

most_painful_user_scenarios: A student used AI to draft an essay and now worries it sounds too robotic.
A writer wants to check AI-likelihood signals before revising a draft.
A student wants to know which sentences need rewriting instead of rewriting the whole essay blindly.
A user needs a quick check and revision workflow without committing to a subscription.
forbidden_claims: Do not say Clearfy guarantees bypassing Turnitin or any AI detector.
Do not promise 0% AI detection or guaranteed undetectability.
Do not encourage academic dishonesty, plagiarism, or submitting unreviewed AI-generated work.
Do not say detector results are perfectly accurate.
Do not say Clearfy replaces the user's own writing, judgment, or responsibility.
Do not claim every school or detector will produce the same result.
good_tiktok_angles: If your essay sounds too much like ChatGPT, check this first.
Before submitting an AI-assisted draft, I check which sentences sound robotic.
I stopped rewriting the whole essay and started fixing the sentences that looked AI-heavy.
This is how I make an AI-assisted draft sound more like my own writing.
No subscription, just credits when I need to check or revise a draft.
product.source_grounding_note: Clearfy's public site describes AI detector and AI humanizer workflows for checking AI-likelihood signals and revising drafts into more natural writing.
allowed_claim_boundaries: Can say Clearfy helps users check AI-likelihood signals in drafts.
Can say Clearfy helps rewrite robotic or AI-heavy phrasing into more natural language.
Can say Clearfy provides sentence-level review signals when visible in the recorded workflow.
Can say credits do not expire if using pricing/credit footage.
Should still say users need to review, edit, and take responsibility for the final writing.
